findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_supply, check_availability, refresh_quote, set_booking_travelers, open_saved_card_setup, cancel_booking, get_booking_status, booking_support, start_email_change, get_profile · Private data: search_supply, check_availability, create_quote, confirm_booking, get_booking_status, request_data_export, start_account_closure, start_split_payment, ask_someone_to_pay · Public sink: initiate_booking, set_booking_guest_answers, set_booking_travelers, get_booking_status, booking_support, update_profile, start_email_change, request_data_export, start_account_closure, start_split_payment, get_split_payment, ask_someone_to_pay, get_profile · Destructive: cancel_booking, update_profile, list_connections, start_account_closure.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_supply, check_availability, refresh_quote, set_booking_travelers, open_saved_card_setup, cancel_booking, get_booking_status, booking_support, start_email_change, get_profile · Private data: search_supply, check_availability, create_quote, confirm_booking, get_booking_status, request_data_export, start_account_closure, start_split_payment, ask_someone_to_pay · Public sink: initiate_booking, set_booking_guest_answers, set_booking_travelers, get_booking_status, booking_support, update_profile, start_email_change, request_data_export, start_account_closure, start_split_payment, get_split_payment, ask_someone_to_pay, get_profile · Destructive: cancel_booking, update_profile, list_connections, start_account_closure

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
